Which shortwave stations broadcast in Tibetan?

In the A-26 schedule, 10 stations broadcast in Tibetan. The most heavily scheduled include Xizang RTV, China National Radio 11, Voice of America, Voice of Tibet.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Tibetan?

The most-used frequencies are 6075, 4905, 4920, 6025, 6130 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
